Google TV doesn't list other apps' screensavers in its settings: it takes a computer on the same Wi-Fi, once.

This TV's address: %1$s

The QR code opens these steps on your phone.

Without a computer, “Start screensaver” shows it whenever you want.
Settings → System → About → press OK 7 times on \"Android TV OS build\".
Settings → System → Developer options → Wireless debugging → \"Pair device with pairing code\". Leave that screen open.
On the computer, with adb (Android\'s platform-tools)

adb pair %1$s:PORT CODE
adb connect %1$s:PORT
adb shell settings put secure screensaver_components %2$s

The pairing port and code are on the TV's screen; the port to connect to is under Wireless debugging.
adb shell settings put secure screensaver_components %1$s
